summary: Per-word retrospective annotation of a shared performance, temporary school cape loan, costume-role reframing, physical stage action and completed return.

ambiguities.issue: School label and temporary permission support school ownership and Nia borrowing; yours denotes assigned costume in Rafi’s utterance. Rafi receives custody and wears the cape, but no ownership transfer or separate formally authorized subloan is invented.
Rafi’s supposed-to Moon line is a context-supported ironic complaint, not an actual teacher instruction to portray Moon. The imagined audience response remains hypothetical.
Nia fetches the disk and Rafi next holds it. The handoff is unreported; endpoints are preserved without inventing a transfer event.
The robe is predominantly gray and a silver strip is visible; preserve local appearance descriptions rather than globally recoloring the robe.
The closing blue ribbon may be the previously loosened ribbon, but this identity is not explicit; its membership in Nia’s ribbons is established.
Final cape-between-crescent-and-ribbon layout is explicitly in the mirror. No unreported robe return or physical undressing movement is inferred.
3:12 supplies clock components without a date or meridiem. Two minutes to places is anchored to Vale’s later announcement, not assumed to end at 3:14.
Stop knocking presupposes earlier lamp knocking while the mother’s request is not proof of compliance. Prior knocking is separately marked through presupposition_projection, not newly desired.
The moving costume element is unspecified; Rafi’s exact emotion and Nia’s stomach-jump emotion are unnamed, and standing taller does not itself assert confidence.

feature_gaps.meaning: Wearing and temporary costume assignment in relation to fictional roles
feature_gaps.resolution: Existing possession_user, enactment, role events and explicit assigned-costume description suffice; no new field proposed.

feature_gaps.meaning: Presupposed prior action embedded under requested cessation
feature_gaps.resolution: Use presupposition_projection, a positive content proposition and the request’s separate target. A future validator can check that operator and embedded event are not collapsed.

prompt_feedback: Readiness questions need an understood addressee subject; the quoted speaker is not automatically the person whose readiness is asked about.
A give/take pair may be one handoff from opposite perspectives. Reuse event identity and keep the grammatical subject distinct from the canonical transfer actor.
Performed first-person speech needs physical speaker and represented character identities, plus its own world and desired-purpose scope.
Novel metaphors such as says MOON and swallowed shoulders require representation links, not literal writing or ingestion events.

Utterance content preserves spoken operators such as need and know, but omits an extra outer says/thinks wrapper supplied only by annotation. Nested belief content is the proposition believed, separate from the whole holder-plus-attitude proposition.
coverage_notes: All 783 words received contextual POS and lemma choices after reading all 1,024 catalog definitions and frozen v2 inputs. Sparse semantic selections are grounded per occurrence; punctuation and spaces are synthetic. Complete assembled-paragraph review is performed before final delivery.
